description: This file defines a service for sending messages via Feishu (Lark) API, including functions to obtain tenant access tokens and send post messages, with some message content and logging setup.

methods.name: getTenantAccessTokenByTenantKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a tenant access token from Feishu API using tenant key.

methods.name: sendPostMsg
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a post message to a specified user via Feishu API, returning response code and message.
